confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from aggregated but secondary sources (Numbeo-style averages relayed by other sites, plus happy-hour and hotel-bar menus), so restaurant and drink anchors are medium confidence. Meal and cocktail anchors are bounded midpoints because sources disagree widely. Wine glass has no direct Orlando average; its value is set above happy-hour wine and below hotel-bar prosecco, using beer as a local price reference. Accommodation anchors are low-confidence holistic model estimates for July peak season near the theme parks, not based on live listings or accommodation searches. The FX observation is the latest RBA figure I could retrieve (20 March 2026), which is stale relative to the 2026-11-19 generation date; a non-RBA figure for October 2026 was seen but excluded as unverified.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Basis is a US mid-sized tourist city with theme-park-driven demand. Food and drink anchors use aggregated Orlando price data, with happy-hour and hotel-bar prices used only as bounds. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for summer tourist demand.
